name: Neritic-Menhir

civilization.name: The Ossuarine Choirs
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Heat is the local god. Fissures glow along every fault line, the air tastes of sulfur past an ancient meteor crater, and by dark the ground itself still glows faintly, like a banked furnace.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
For traders, exotic matter and uranium alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
